# Chemist

[All quest chapters](index.md)

## Become a Chemist

Hiluluk's last experiment turned the snow of Drum pink, years after he was gone.

Choose Chemist as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Chemist

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Chemist XP +300

<a id="q-7f873756958e6a68"></a>

## Apprentice Chemist

Every cure starts in a laboratory that smells terrible.

Reach Chemist level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Chemist](chemist.md#q-75e0ba41ccbfe72b)

**Tasks**

- Reach Chemist level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Chemist XP +800

<a id="q-1fd8bafa0935318d"></a>

## Journeyman Chemist

Drum Island's doctors treat a whole kingdom of frostbite. Practise on its patients.

Reach Chemist level 25, Compound a Healing Tonic, Compound an Antidote Powder and land on a winter island in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Chemist](chemist.md#q-7f873756958e6a68)

**Tasks**

- Reach Chemist level 25
- Compound a Healing Tonic
- Compound an Antidote Powder
- Land on a winter island in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Chemist XP +3,000

<a id="q-676bde7eada55426"></a>

## Expert Chemist

The Rumble Ball took Chopper five years to perfect. Brew it, and the strongest remedy there is.

Reach Chemist level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Chemist](chemist.md#q-1fd8bafa0935318d)

**Tasks**

- Reach Chemist level 50
- Compound a Rumble Ball
- Compound a Restorative Drug

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Chemist XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-2616ad0791cf58cc"></a>

## Master Chemist

Drum remembers its doctors. Become the one it remembers next.

Reach Chemist level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Chemist](chemist.md#q-676bde7eada55426)

**Tasks**

- Reach Chemist level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
